name: phpdot/ai
description: LLM client layer for the PHPdot ecosystem — one streaming turn API over the two wire shapes that matter (Anthropic /messages and OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions), with tools, usage, and mid-turn cancellation, on ext-curl that yields coroutines under Swoole hooks.

suggest.phpdot/container: Autowires the #[Singleton] Drivers accessor (the attribute stays inert until reflected, so standalone consumers don't need it installed) (^0.3).
suggest.ext-swoole: The runtime the client is proven under — with SWOOLE_HOOK_ALL and SWOOLE_HOOK_NATIVE_CURL on, each turn's curl yields the coroutine instead of blocking the worker for the minutes a hard prompt can take.
